title: Theme Configuration
description: Defines a Kampose theme's inheritance, metadata, templates, bundled resources, static assets, and configurable parameters.

$schema.description: Not recommended in theme configuration files. Retained only for compatibility. The canonical hosted schema represents the latest Kampose release and may not match an installed or pinned version, and installation-relative schema paths are not portable. Kampose does not use this value during loading. Editors and agents should instead validate out of band using the schema matching every effective Kampose version.

base.description: Directory name of the parent theme to inherit, or null for a standalone theme. Templates, bundles, assets, and parameter definitions in this theme take precedence over inherited entries with the same name or target path. A standalone theme must define at least one template pattern.

metadata.description: Optional descriptive information about the theme. Metadata is exposed to templates but does not control theme loading or output selection.

format.description: Output format the theme is intended to render, such as "html" or "md". This value is informational; the documentation convention selects the actual output format.

name.description: Human-readable theme name for documentation or user interfaces.

version.description: Theme release version displayed as metadata. Kampose does not interpret or compare this value.

description.description: Brief summary of the theme's intended use or distinguishing features.

author.description: Person or organization that maintains the theme.

license.description: License name or identifier under which the theme is distributed, such as "MIT".

homepage.description: Absolute URL for the theme's homepage, source repository, or documentation.

templates.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns, relative to this theme's directory, that select Handlebars templates. Patterns without an extension are treated as .hbs patterns. Each template is registered by filename without its extension; this theme wins when an inherited theme defines the same template name.

source.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns, relative to this theme's directory, that select JavaScript files for concatenation and minification. Patterns without an extension are treated as .js patterns.

targetPath.description: Output-relative path of the generated JavaScript bundle. The parent directory is created when needed. Defaults to "script.js".

scripts.description: Defines a JavaScript bundle. Matching files are concatenated and minified into targetPath; the first generated script bundle also receives the global window.kampose data used by theme scripts.

source.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns, relative to this theme's directory, that select CSS files for concatenation and minification. Patterns without an extension are treated as .css patterns.

targetPath.description: Output-relative path of the generated stylesheet bundle. The parent directory is created when needed. Defaults to "styles.css".

styles.description: Defines a stylesheet bundle. Matching files are concatenated and minified into targetPath.

assets.description: Case-insensitive glob patterns, relative to this theme's directory, that select static files to copy unchanged. Paths relative to the theme directory are preserved in the output, and this theme wins when an inherited theme provides the same path.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive parameter definitions used to validate themeSettings and provide defaults. Resolved non-null values are exposed by name to Handlebars templates and, when a script bundle exists, through window.kampose.config.

type.description: Expected value type. markdown accepts Markdown text and renders it as a reusable partial; uri accepts absolute or relative URI references; array and object accept structured JSON values.

description.description: User-facing explanation of where the parameter is used, what effect it has, and any expected structure or interactions with other parameters.

defaultValue.description: Fallback used when themeSettings does not provide a non-null value. Its JSON type must match type; null means the parameter is omitted from template and script data unless configured.
